units.zh: 聖宗一
units.en: Shengzong, Part One
units.literal: Shengzong, Part One

units.zh: 聖宗文武大孝宣皇帝，諱隆緒，小字文殊奴。
units.en: The Emperor Shengzong, posthumous title Wenwu Daxiao Xuan, personal name Longxu, childhood name Wenshunu.
units.literal: Emperor Shengzong Wenwu Daxiao Xuan, taboo name Longxu, childhood name Wenshunu.

units.zh: 景宗皇帝長子，母曰睿智皇后蕭氏。
units.en: He was the eldest son of Emperor Jingzong; his mother was Empress Ruizhi, née Xiao.
units.literal: Eldest son of Emperor Jingzong; his mother was Empress Ruizhi of the Xiao clan.

units.zh: 帝幼喜書翰，十歲能詩。
units.en: As a boy the Emperor delighted in letters and brushwork; by ten he could write verse.
units.literal: From childhood the Emperor loved writing; at ten he could compose poetry.

units.zh: 既長，精射法，曉音律，好繪畫。
units.en: When he came of age he excelled at archery, knew music, and took pleasure in painting.
units.literal: Once grown, he mastered archery, understood music, and loved painting.

units.zh: 乾亨二年，封梁王。
units.en: In the second year of Qianheng he received the title Prince of Liang.
units.literal: In the second year of Qianheng he was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang.

units.zh: 四年秋九月壬子，景宗崩。
units.en: In the fourth year, on renzi day in the ninth autumn month, Jingzong died.
units.literal: In the fourth year, autumn, ninth month, on renzi day, Jingzong died.

units.zh: 癸丑，即皇帝位於柩前，時年十二。
units.en: On guichou day he assumed the throne before the coffin; he was twelve years old.
units.literal: On guichou day, he took the imperial throne before the coffin; he was then twelve years old.

units.zh: 皇后奉遺詔攝政，詔諭諸道。
units.en: The Empress assumed regency under the testamentary edict, and an edict was issued to notify all circuits.
units.literal: The Empress carried out regency by testamentary edict; an edict was issued to instruct all circuits.

units.zh: 冬十月己未朔，帝始臨朝。
units.en: In winter, on the jiwei new moon of the tenth month, the Emperor held his first audience.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiwei new moon, the Emperor first held court.

units.zh: 辛酉，群臣上尊號曰昭聖皇帝，尊皇后為皇太后，大赦。
units.en: On xinyou day the hundred officials offered the honorific title Emperor Zhaosheng, the Empress was honored as Empress Dowager, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: On xinyou day the hundred officials offered the honorific title Emperor Zhaosheng; the Empress was honored as Empress Dowager; a general amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 以南院大王勃古哲總領山西諸州事，北院大王、於越休哥為南面行軍都統，奚王和朔奴副之，同政事門下平章事蕭道寧領本部軍駐南京。
units.en: Southern Route great king Boguzhe was placed in overall charge of the western circuits; Northern Route great king and yuyue Xiuge was made Southern Route campaign commander-in-chief, with Xi King Heshuonu as his deputy; co-chancellor under the Gate Xiao Daoning led his own army in garrison at Nanjing.
units.literal: Southern Route great king Boguzhe was put in overall charge of the western circuits; Northern Route great king and yuyue Xiuge was made Southern Route campaign commander-in-chief, with Xi King Heshuonu as his deputy; co-chancellor under the Gate Xiao Daoning led his own army in garrison at Nanjing.

units.zh: 己丑，如顯州。
units.en: On jichou day the Emperor went to Xian Prefecture.
units.literal: On jichou day, he went to Xian Prefecture.

units.zh: 十一月甲午，置乾州。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on jiawu day, Qian Prefecture was established.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiawu day, Qian Prefecture was established.

units.zh: 十二月戊午朔，耶律速撒討阻卜。
units.en: On the wuwu new moon of the twelfth month, Yelü Susa campaigned against the Zubu.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuwu new moon, Yelü Susa campaigned against the Zubu.

units.zh: 辛酉，南京留守荊王道隱奏宋遣使獻犀帶請和，詔以無書卻之。
units.en: On xinyou day Nanjing regent Prince of Jing Daoyin reported that Song had sent envoys with rhinoceros-horn belts to sue for peace; an edict rejected the overture because no formal letter accompanied it.
units.literal: On xinyou day, Nanjing regent Prince of Jing Daoyin reported that Song had sent envoys offering rhinoceros-horn belts and suing for peace; an edict refused on the grounds that no formal letter had been sent.

units.zh: 甲子，撻剌幹乃萬十醉言宮掖事，法當死，杖而釋之。
units.en: On jiazi day Tatala Gannai Wanshi spoke of inner-palace affairs while drunk — a capital offense by law — but was beaten with the rod and released.
units.literal: On jiazi day, Tatala Gannai Wanshi, speaking while drunk of inner-palace affairs, should by law have died, but was caned and released.

units.zh: 辛未，西南面招討使秦王韓匡嗣薨。
units.en: On xinwei day Han Kuangsi, Prince of Qin and southwestern campaign commissioner, died.
units.literal: On xinwei day, Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi, southwestern campaign commissioner, died.

units.zh: 癸酉，奉大行皇帝梓宮於菆塗殿。
units.en: On guiyou day the late Emperor's coffin was escorted to Zaitu Hall.
units.literal: On guiyou day, the late Emperor's coffin was escorted to Zaitu Hall.

units.zh: 庚辰，省置中臺省官。
units.en: On gengchen day the offices of the Central Secretariat were streamlined.
units.literal: On gengchen day, offices of the Central Secretariat were reduced and reorganized.

units.zh: 統和元年春正月戊午朔，以大行在殯，不受朝。
units.en: In the first year of Tonghe, on the wuwu new moon of the first spring month, with the late emperor's coffin still in state, the court held no audience.
units.literal: In the first year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on wuwu day the new moon, because the late emperor's body lay in state, audience was not held.

units.zh: 乙丑，奉遺詔，召先帝庶兄質睦於菆塗殿前，復封寧王。
units.en: On yichou day, in accordance with the testamentary edict, the late emperor's elder half-brother Zhimu was called before the Zaitu Hall and restored as Prince of Ning.
units.literal: On yichou day, following the testamentary edict, the late emperor's younger half-brother Zhimu was summoned before the Zaitu Hall and re-enfeoffed as Prince of Ning.

units.zh: 加宰相室昉、宣徽使普領等恩。
units.en: Chancellor Shifang, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling, and others received added honors.
units.literal: Chancellor Shifang, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling, and others were granted additional favor.

units.zh: 丙寅，荊王道隱有疾，詔遣使存問。
units.en: On bingyin day Prince of Jing Daoyin took ill, and an edict sent envoys to inquire after him.
units.literal: On bingyin day Prince of Jing Daoyin fell ill; an edict dispatched envoys to inquire after his health.

units.zh: 是日，皇太后幸其邸視疾。
units.en: That same day the Empress Dowager went in person to his residence to visit him.
units.literal: That same day the Empress Dowager visited his residence to see him.

units.zh: 戊辰，以烏隈烏骨裏部節度使耶律章瓦同政事門下平章事。
units.en: On wuchen day Yelü Zhangwa, military commissioner of the Wuyu Wuguli division, was appointed co-director of the Secretariat with the rank of co-chancellor under the Gate.
units.literal: On wuchen day Yelü Zhangwa, military commissioner of the Wuyu Wuguli division, was made co-director of the Secretariat with the rank of co-chancellor under the Gate.

units.zh: 甲戌，荊王道隱薨，輟朝三日，追封晉王，遣使撫慰其家。
units.en: On jiaxu day Prince of Jing Daoyin died; court mourning lasted three days; he was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Jin, and envoys were sent to comfort his family.
units.literal: On jiaxu day Prince of Jing Daoyin died; court was suspended three days; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Jin; envoys were sent to comfort his household.

units.zh: 丙子，以於越休哥為南京留守，仍賜南面行營總管印綬，總邊事，渤海撻馬解裏以受先帝厚恩，乞殉葬，詔不許，賜物以旌之。
units.en: On bingzi day yuyue Xiuge was appointed Nanjing regent and given the seal and cord of Southern Route camp commander-in-chief to oversee the frontier; Bohai tamasa Jieli, who had received the late emperor's great kindness, begged to follow him in death; the court refused but rewarded him with gifts.
units.literal: On bingzi day yuyue Xiuge was made Nanjing regent and given the seal and cord of Southern Route camp commander-in-chief to oversee border affairs; Bohai tamasa Jieli, having received the late emperor's great favor, asked to be buried alive with him; an edict refused but granted gifts to honor him.

units.zh: 戊寅，遣使賜於越休哥及奚王籌寧、統軍使頗德等湯藥。
units.en: On wuyin day envoys were dispatched with medicinal broth for yuyue Xiuge, Xi King Chouning, circuit military commissioner Pide, and others.
units.literal: On wuyin day envoys were sent with medicinal broth to yuyue Xiuge, Xi King Chouning, circuit military commissioner Pide, and others.

units.zh: 命懇篤持送休哥下車榜，以諭燕民。
units.en: Ken Du was ordered to carry and post Xiuge's proclamation on alighting from his carriage, to reassure the people of Yan.
units.literal: Ken Du was ordered to carry and post Xiuge's proclamation on alighting from the carriage, to instruct the people of Yan.

units.zh: 辛巳，速撒獻阻卜俘。
units.en: On xinsi day Susa presented prisoners taken from the Zubu.
units.literal: On xinsi day Susa presented Zubu captives.

units.zh: 壬午，涿州刺史安吉奏宋築城河北，詔留守於越休哥撓之，勿令就功。
units.en: On renwu day Anji, prefect of Zhuo, reported that Song was building fortifications north of the Yellow River; an edict ordered regent yuyue Xiuge to thwart the work and prevent its completion.
units.literal: On renwu day Anji, prefect of Zhuo, reported that Song was building fortifications north of the Yellow River; an edict ordered regent yuyue Xiuge to obstruct it and not let the work be completed.

units.zh: 趙妃及公主胡骨典、奚王籌寧、宰相安寧、北大王普奴寧、惕隱屈烈、吳王稍、寧王只沒與橫帳、國舅、契丹、漢官等並進助山陵費。
units.en: Consort Zhao, Princess Hugudian, Xi King Chouning, Chancellor Anning, Northern Court Great King Pununing, tihu Qulie, Prince of Wu Shao, Prince of Ning Zhimei, members of the horizontal tents, imperial in-laws, Khitan, and Han officials all contributed to the mausoleum expenses.
units.literal: Consort Zhao, Princess Hugudian, Xi King Chouning, Chancellor Anning, Northern Court Great King Pununing, tihu Qulie, Prince of Wu Shao, Prince of Ning Zhimei, members of the horizontal tents, imperial in-laws, Khitan, and Han officials all contributed toward the mausoleum expenses.

units.zh: 癸未，齊國公主率內外命婦進物如之。
units.en: On guiwei day the Princess of Qi led the inner and outer titled ladies in presenting gifts in the same manner.
units.literal: On guiwei day the Princess of Qi led the inner and outer titled ladies in presenting gifts likewise.

units.zh: 甲申，西南面招討使韓德威奏党項十五部侵邊，以兵擊破之。
units.en: On jiashen day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei reported that fifteen Tangut divisions had raided the frontier; troops were dispatched and routed them.
units.literal: On jiashen day Southwest Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei reported that fifteen Tangut divisions had invaded the border; troops were sent and defeated them.

units.zh: 乙酉，以速撒破阻卜，下詔褒美；
units.en: On yiyou day, because Susa had broken the Zubu, an edict commended him;
units.literal: On yiyou day, because Susa had defeated the Zubu, an edict praised him;

units.zh: 仍諭與大漢討党項諸部。
units.en: he was also ordered to join Dahan in campaigning against the Tangut divisions.
units.literal: he was also instructed to join Dahan in campaigning against the Tangut divisions.

units.zh: 丁亥，樞密使兼政事令室昉以年老請解兼職，詔不允。
units.en: On dinghai day Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Shifang, citing age, asked to be relieved of his concurrent office; the court refused.
units.literal: On dinghai day Commissioner of Military Affairs and Chief Councillor Shifang, being old, requested to be relieved of his concurrent post; an edict refused.

units.zh: 二月戊子朔，禁所在官吏軍民不得無故聚眾私語及冒禁夜行，違者坐之。
units.en: On the wuzi new moon of the second month, officials, soldiers, and civilians everywhere were forbidden to gather in crowds for private talk or to travel at night in violation of curfew; offenders would be punished.
units.literal: In the second month, on the wuzi new moon, officials and soldiers and civilians everywhere were forbidden to gather in crowds for private talk or to travel at night in violation of curfew; violators would be punished.

units.zh: 己丑，南京奏，聞宋多聚糧邊境及宋主將如臺山，詔休哥嚴為之備。
units.en: On jichou day Nanjing reported that Song was stockpiling grain on the frontier and that the Song emperor would soon visit Mount Tai; an edict ordered Xiuge to prepare defenses strictly.
units.literal: On jichou day Nanjing reported that Song was stockpiling grain on the border and that the Song ruler would soon go to Mount Tai; an edict ordered Xiuge to make strict preparations.

units.zh: 甲午，葬景宗皇帝於乾陵，以近幸朗、掌飲伶人撻魯為殉。
units.en: On jiawu day Emperor Jingzong was interred at Qian Mausoleum; the close attendants Lang and the wine-serving entertainer Dalu were buried alive with him.
units.literal: On jiawu day Emperor Jingzong was buried at Qian Mausoleum; the close attendants Lang and the wine-serving entertainer Dalu were buried alive with him.

units.zh: 上與皇太后因為書附上大行。
units.en: The Emperor and the Empress Dowager each wrote a letter and placed it with the late emperor's coffin.
units.literal: The Emperor and the Empress Dowager each wrote a letter and attached it to the late emperor's coffin.

units.zh: 丙申，皇太后詣陵置奠，命繪近臣於御容殿，賜山陵工人物有差。
units.en: On bingshen day the Empress Dowager went to the mausoleum to offer sacrifice; she ordered portraits of close ministers painted in the Imperial Portrait Hall and rewarded the mausoleum workers according to rank.
units.literal: On bingshen day the Empress Dowager went to the mausoleum to offer sacrifice; she ordered portraits of close ministers painted in the Imperial Portrait Hall and granted the mausoleum workers gifts in differing amounts.

units.zh: 庚子，以先帝遺物賜皇族及近臣。
units.en: On gengzi day the late emperor's personal effects were distributed to the imperial clan and close ministers.
units.literal: On gengzi day the late emperor's personal effects were granted to the imperial clan and close ministers.

units.zh: 辛丑，南京統軍使耶律善補奏宋邊七十餘村來附，詔撫存之。
units.en: On xinchou day Nanjing circuit military commissioner Yelü Shanbu reported that more than seventy Song border villages had submitted; an edict ordered them settled and cared for.
units.literal: On xinchou day Nanjing circuit military commissioner Yelü Shanbu reported that more than seventy Song border villages had come over; an edict ordered them settled and cared for.

units.zh: 乙巳，以御容殿為玉殿，酒谷為聖谷。
units.en: On yisi day the court renamed the Imperial Portrait Hall the Jade Hall and Wine Valley the Sacred Valley.
units.literal: On yisi day the Imperial Portrait Hall was renamed the Jade Hall, and Wine Valley was renamed Sacred Valley.

units.zh: 速撒奏討党項捷，遣使慰勞。
units.en: Susa reported victory over the Tangut; envoys were dispatched to comfort and reward the troops.
units.literal: Susa reported victory in the campaign against the Tangut; envoys were sent to comfort and reward the troops.

units.zh: 戊申，以惕隱化哥為北院大王，解領為南府宰相。
units.en: On wushen day tihu Huage was appointed Northern Court Great King, and Jieling was made Southern Prime Minister.
units.literal: On wushen day tihu Huage was made Northern Court Great King, and Jieling was made Southern Prime Minister.

units.zh: 辛亥，幸聖山，遂謁三陵。
units.en: On xinhai day the court visited Sacred Mountain and then paid respects at the three imperial tombs.
units.literal: On xinhai day the court visited Sacred Mountain and then paid respects at the three mausoleums.

units.zh: 甲寅，以皇女長壽公主下嫁國舅宰相蕭婆項之子吳留。
units.en: On jiayin day Princess Changshou was married to Wuliu, son of imperial in-law and chancellor Xiao Poxiang.
units.literal: On jiayin day the imperial daughter Princess Changshou was given in marriage to Wuliu, son of imperial in-law and chancellor Xiao Poxiang.

units.zh: 三月戊午，天德軍節度使頹剌父子戰歿，以其弟涅離襲爵。
units.en: In the third month, on wuwu day, Tiande Army Military Commissioner Tuila and his son were killed in battle; his younger brother Nieli inherited the post.
units.literal: In the third month, on wuwu day, Tiande Army Military Commissioner Tuila and his son died in battle; his younger brother Nieli succeeded to the title.

units.zh: 己未，次獨山。
units.en: On jiwei day the court encamped at Solitary Mountain.
units.literal: On jiwei day the court halted at Solitary Mountain.

units.zh: 遣使賞西南面有功將士。
units.en: Envoys were sent to reward the meritorious officers and soldiers on the southwest frontier.
units.literal: Envoys were dispatched to reward the meritorious officers and soldiers of the southwest.

units.zh: 辛酉，以大父帳太慰耶律曷魯寧為惕隱。
units.en: On xinyou day Yelü Heluning of the grand-father's tent was appointed tihu.
units.literal: On xinyou day grand-father's tent Grand Guardian Yelü Heluning was made tihu.

units.zh: 甲子，駐蹕遼河之平澱。
units.en: On jiazi day the court made camp at the Pingdian ford of the Liao River.
units.literal: On jiazi day the court halted at the Pingdian ford of the Liao River.

units.zh: 辛巳，以國舅、同平章事蕭道寧為遼興軍節度使，仍賜號忠亮佐理功臣。
units.en: On xinsi day imperial in-law and co-chancellor Xiao Daoning was appointed Liaoxing Army military commissioner and granted the title Meritorious Minister of Loyal Brightness and Aiding Governance.
units.literal: On xinsi day imperial in-law and co-chancellor Xiao Daoning was made Liaoxing Army military commissioner and also granted the title Meritorious Minister of Loyal Brightness and Aiding Governance.

units.zh: 壬午，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: On renwu day the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On renwu day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 夏四月丙戌朔，幸東京。
units.en: On the bingxu new moon of the fourth summer month the court visited the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the bingxu new moon, the court visited the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 以樞密副使耶律末只兼侍中，為東京留守。
units.en: Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Mojie was also made Palace Attendant and appointed regent of the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Mojie was additionally made Palace Attendant and appointed Eastern Capital regent.

units.zh: 庚寅，謁太祖廟。
units.en: On gengyin day the court visited Taizu Temple in homage.
units.literal: On gengyin day the court paid respects at Taizu Temple.

units.zh: 癸巳，詔賜物命婦寡居者。
units.en: On guisi day an edict ordered gifts granted to titled ladies living in widowhood.
units.literal: On guisi day an edict granted gifts to titled ladies living in widowhood.

units.zh: 丙申，南幸。
units.en: On bingshen day the Emperor traveled south.
units.literal: On bingshen day the court traveled south.

units.zh: 辛丑，謁三陵，以東京所進物分賜陵寢官吏。
units.en: On xinchou day the court paid respects at the three mausoleums and distributed the goods sent from the Eastern Capital among the tomb officials.
units.literal: On xinchou day the court paid respects at the three mausoleums and distributed the goods presented from the Eastern Capital among the mausoleum officials.

units.zh: 復詔賜西南路招討使大漢劍，不用命者得專殺。
units.en: An edict again granted Southwest Route pacification commissioner Dahan a sword, authorizing him to execute on the spot anyone who disobeyed orders.
units.literal: An edict was again issued granting Southwest Route pacification commissioner Dahan a sword; those who disobeyed orders could be summarily executed.

units.zh: 壬寅，致享於凝神殿。
units.en: On renyin day the court offered sacrifice at the Ningshen Hall.
units.literal: On renyin day sacrifice was offered at the Ningshen Hall.

units.zh: 癸卯，謁乾陵。
units.en: On guimao day the court visited Qian Mausoleum in homage.
units.literal: On guimao day the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 乙巳，遣人以酒脯祭平章耶律河陽墓。
units.en: On yisi day envoys were sent with wine and dried meat to offer sacrifice at the tomb of co-chancellor Yelü Heyang.
units.literal: On yisi day envoys were sent with wine and dried meat to sacrifice at the tomb of co-chancellor Yelü Heyang.

units.zh: 庚戌，幸夫人烏骨裏第，謁太祖御容，禮畢，幸公主胡古典第飲，賜與甚厚。
units.en: On gengxu day the court visited Lady Wuguli's residence; after paying respects to Taizu's portrait, it went to Princess Hugudian's residence for a banquet and bestowed lavish gifts.
units.literal: On gengxu day the court visited the residence of Lady Wuguli; after paying respects to Taizu's portrait, it visited Princess Hugudian's residence for a banquet and granted gifts very generously.

units.zh: 壬子，大臣以太后預政，宜有尊號，請下有司詳定冊禮。
units.en: On renzi day the ministers, because the Empress Dowager would share in government, argued that she should receive an honorific title and asked the relevant offices to draft the investiture rites in detail.
units.literal: On renzi day the ministers, because the Empress Dowager would participate in government, said she ought to receive an honorific title and asked that the relevant offices be ordered to draft the investiture rite in detail.

units.zh: 詔樞密院諭沿邊節將，至行禮日，止遣子弟奉表稱賀，恐失邊備。
units.en: An edict instructed the Commissioner of Military Affairs to notify frontier commanders that on the day of the rite they should send only their sons with congratulatory memorials, lest border defenses suffer.
units.literal: An edict instructed the Commissioner of Military Affairs to notify frontier commanders that on the day of the rite they should send only their sons to submit congratulatory memorials, lest border defense be neglected.

units.zh: 樞密請詔北府司徒頗德譯南京所進律文，從之。
units.en: The Commissioner of Military Affairs asked that an edict order Northern Prime Minister Pide to translate the legal texts submitted from Nanjing; the request was granted.
units.literal: The Commissioner of Military Affairs requested an edict ordering Northern Prime Minister Pide to translate the legal texts submitted from Nanjing; this was approved.

units.zh: 遂如徽州。
units.en: The court then proceeded to Huizhou.
units.literal: The court then went to Huizhou.

units.zh: 以耶律慶朗為信州節度使。
units.en: Yelü Qinglang was appointed Xinzhou military commissioner.
units.literal: Yelü Qinglang was made Xinzhou military commissioner.

units.zh: 五月丙辰朔，國舅、政事門下平章事蕭道寧以皇太后慶壽，請歸父母家行禮，而齊國公主及命婦、群臣各進物。
units.en: On the bingchen new moon of the fifth month, imperial in-law and co-chancellor Xiao Daoning, because the Empress Dowager was celebrating her birthday, asked to return to his parents' home to perform the rite; the Princess of Qi, titled ladies, and officials each presented gifts.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the bingchen new moon, imperial in-law and co-chancellor Xiao Daoning, because the Empress Dowager was celebrating her birthday, asked to return to his parents' home to perform the rite; the Princess of Qi, titled ladies, and the officials each presented gifts.

units.zh: 設宴，賜國舅帳耆年物有差。
units.en: A banquet was held and the elders of the imperial in-law tents were rewarded with gifts according to rank.
units.literal: A banquet was held and gifts were granted in differing amounts to the elders of the imperial in-law tents.

units.zh: 壬戌，西南路招討請益兵討西突厥諸部，詔北王府耶律蒲奴寧以敵畢、叠烈二部兵赴之。
units.en: On renxu day the Southwest Route pacification commissioner asked for reinforcements against the Western Turkic divisions; an edict ordered Northern Court Prince Yelü Pununing to march with the Dibi and Dielie divisions to his aid.
units.literal: On renxu day the Southwest Route pacification commissioner requested additional troops to campaign against the Western Turkic divisions; an edict ordered Northern Court Prince Yelü Pununing to lead the Dibi and Dielie divisions to join him.

units.zh: 癸亥，以於越休哥在南院過用吏人，詔南大王毋相循襲。
units.en: On guihai day, because yuyue Xiuge had overused clerks in the Southern Court, an edict warned the Southern Court Great King not to follow suit.
units.literal: On guihai day, because yuyue Xiuge had overused clerks in the Southern Court, an edict ordered the Southern Court Great King not to follow the same practice.

units.zh: 庚午，耶律善補招亡入宋者，得千餘戶歸國，詔令撫慰。
units.en: On gengwu day Yelü Shanbu recruited fugitives who had entered Song and brought back more than a thousand households; an edict ordered them settled and reassured.
units.literal: On gengwu day Yelü Shanbu recruited those who had fled into Song and recovered more than a thousand households for the state; an edict ordered them settled and comforted.

units.zh: 辛未，次永州，祭王子藥師奴墓。
units.en: On xinwei day the court encamped at Yongzhou and offered sacrifice at the tomb of Prince Yaoshinü.
units.literal: On xinwei day the court halted at Yongzhou and sacrificed at the tomb of Prince Yaoshinü.

units.zh: 乙亥，詔近臣議皇太后上尊號冊禮，樞密使韓德度以後漢太后臨朝故事草定上之。
units.en: On yihai day an edict ordered close ministers to discuss the Empress Dowager's honorific investiture; Commissioner of Military Affairs Han Dedu drafted a plan based on the Later Han precedent of empress dowager regency and submitted it.
units.literal: On yihai day an edict ordered close ministers to discuss the Empress Dowager's honorific investiture rite; Commissioner of Military Affairs Han Dedu drafted a plan based on the precedent of the Later Han empress dowager's regency and submitted it.

units.zh: 丙子，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: On bingzi day the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
units.literal: On bingzi day a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 戊寅，幸木葉山。
units.en: On wuyin day the Emperor went to Mount Muye.
units.literal: On wuyin day the court visited Mount Muye.

units.zh: 西南路招討使大漢奏，近遣拽剌跋剌哥諭党項諸部，來者甚眾，下詔褒美。
units.en: Southwest Route pacification commissioner Dahan reported that he had recently sent zhaila Balaige to summon the Tangut divisions and a great many had come; an edict commended him.
units.literal: Southwest Route pacification commissioner Dahan reported that he had recently sent zhaila Balaige to summon the Tangut divisions and very many had come; an edict praised him.

units.zh: 六月乙酉朔，詔有司，冊皇太后日，給三品以上法服，三品以下用大射柳之服。
units.en: On the yiyou new moon of the sixth month an edict ordered that on the day of the Empress Dowager's investiture, officials of third rank and above were to receive court robes and those below third rank the great willow-shooting robes.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the yiyou new moon, an edict ordered the relevant offices that on the day the Empress Dowager was invested, officials of third rank and above were to receive court robes, and those below third rank were to wear the great willow-shooting robes.

units.zh: 西南路招討使奏党項酋長執夷離堇子隈引等乞內附，詔撫納之，仍察其誠偽，謹邊備。
units.en: The Southwest Route pacification commissioner reported that Tangut chieftains had seized the yilijin's son Weiyin and others and were begging to submit; an edict ordered them received and settled, but also to test their sincerity and maintain strict border defenses.
units.literal: The Southwest Route pacification commissioner reported that Tangut chieftains including the son of yilijin Zuiyin were begging to submit; an edict ordered them received and settled, but also to watch their sincerity and keep border defenses strict.

units.zh: 丙戌，還上京。
units.en: On bingxu day the court came back to the Supreme Capital.
units.literal: On bingxu day the court returned to the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 己丑，有司奏，同政事門下平章事、駙馬都尉盧俊與公主不協，詔離之，遂出俊為興國軍節度使。
units.en: On jichou day the relevant offices reported that co-chancellor and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-law's Office Lu Jun was estranged from the princess; an edict ordered them separated, and Jun was sent out as Xingguo Army military commissioner.
units.literal: On jichou day the relevant offices reported that co-chancellor and Commissioner of the Imperial Son-in-law's Office Lu Jun was at odds with the princess; an edict ordered them separated, and Jun was then sent out as Xingguo Army military commissioner.

units.zh: 辛卯，有事於太廟。
units.en: On xinmao day the court offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
units.literal: On xinmao day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

units.zh: 甲午，上率群臣上皇太后尊號曰承天皇太后，群臣上皇帝尊號曰天輔皇帝，大赦，改元統和。
units.en: On jiawu day the Emperor led the ministers in honoring the Empress Dowager as Empress Dowager Chengtian; the ministers honored the Emperor as Emperor Tianfu; a grand amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Tonghe.
units.literal: On jiawu day the Emperor led the ministers in submitting to the Empress Dowager the honorific title Empress Dowager Chengtian; the ministers submitted to the Emperor the honorific title Emperor Tianfu; a grand amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Tonghe.

units.zh: 丁未，覃恩中外，文武官各進爵一級。
units.en: On dingwei day favor was extended throughout court and country; civil and military officials each advanced one step in rank.
units.literal: On dingwei day favor was extended throughout court and country; civil and military officials each advanced one rank in nobility.

units.zh: 以樞密副使耶律斜軫守司徒。
units.en: Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Xiezhen was ordered to serve as Minister of Works.
units.literal: Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelü Xiezhen was appointed to hold the post of Minister of Works.

units.zh: 秋七月甲寅朔，皇太后聽政。
units.en: On the jiayin new moon of the seventh autumn month the Empress Dowager began to govern.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the jiayin new moon, the Empress Dowager assumed governance.

units.zh: 乙卯，上親錄囚。
units.en: On yimao day the Emperor personally reviewed the prisoners.
units.literal: On yimao day the Emperor personally reviewed prisoners.

units.zh: 王子司徒婁國坐稱疾不赴山陵，笞二十。
units.en: Prince and Minister of Works Louguo was flogged twenty strokes for feigning illness and failing to attend the mausoleum rites.
units.literal: Prince and Minister of Works Louguo was caned twenty strokes for claiming illness and failing to attend the mausoleum rites.

units.zh: 辛酉，行再生禮。
units.en: On xinyou day the court performed the rebirth rite.
units.literal: On xinyou day the rebirth rite was performed.

units.zh: 癸酉，臨潢尹袞進飲饌。
units.en: On guiyou day Linhuang prefect Gun brought food and drink for the court.
units.literal: On guiyou day Linhuang prefect Gun presented food and drink.

units.zh: 上與諸王分朋擊鞠。
units.en: The Emperor and the princes formed teams and played cuju.
units.literal: The Emperor and the princes divided into teams and played cuju.

units.zh: 丙子，韓德威遣詳穩轄馬上破党項俘獲數，並送夷離堇之子來獻。
units.en: On bingzi day Han Dewei sent xiangwen zhamas to defeat the Tangut and reported the number of captives; the son of a yilijin was also sent as tribute.
units.literal: On bingzi day Han Dewei sent xiangwen zhamas to break the Tangut and sent the number of captives; the son of a yilijin was also sent as tribute.

units.zh: 辛巳，賞西南面有功將士。
units.en: On xinsi day meritorious officers and soldiers on the southwest frontier were rewarded.
units.literal: On xinsi day meritorious officers and soldiers of the southwest were rewarded.

units.zh: 八月戊子，上西巡。
units.en: On wuzi day in the eighth month the Emperor toured west.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on wuzi day, the Emperor toured west.

units.zh: 己丑，謁祖陵。
units.en: On jichou day the court visited the ancestral mausoleum in homage.
units.literal: On jichou day the court paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.

units.zh: 辛卯，皇太后祭楚國王蕭思溫墓。
units.en: On xinmao day the Empress Dowager offered sacrifice at the tomb of Prince of Chu Xiao Siwen.
units.literal: On xinmao day the Empress Dowager sacrificed at the tomb of Prince of Chu Xiao Siwen.

units.zh: 癸巳，上與皇太后謁懷陵，遂幸懷州。
units.en: On guisi day the Emperor and the Empress Dowager visited Huai Mausoleum in homage and then went to Huaizhou.
units.literal: On guisi day the Emperor and the Empress Dowager paid respects at Huai Mausoleum and then visited Huaizhou.

units.zh: 甲午，上與斜軫於太后前易弓矢鞍馬，約以為友。
units.en: On jiawu day before the Empress Dowager the Emperor and Xiezhen exchanged bows, arrows, saddles, and horses and swore friendship.
units.literal: On jiawu day the Emperor and Xiezhen exchanged bows, arrows, saddles, and horses before the Empress Dowager and pledged friendship.

units.zh: 己亥，獵赤山，遣使薦熊肪、鹿脯於乾陵之凝神殿。
units.en: On jihai day the court hunted at Red Mountain and sent envoys to offer bear fat and dried venison at the Ningshen Hall of Qian Mausoleum.
units.literal: On jihai day the court hunted at Red Mountain; envoys were sent to present bear fat and dried venison at the Ningshen Hall of Qian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 以政事令孫楨無子，詔國舅小翁帳郎君桃隈為之後。
units.en: Because Chief Councillor Sun Zhen had no son, an edict made Taowei, a langjun of imperial in-law Xiao Weng's tent, his heir.
units.literal: Because Chief Councillor Sun Zhen had no son, an edict made imperial in-law Xiao Weng's tent langjun Taowei his heir.

units.zh: 乙巳，詔於越休哥提點元城。
units.en: On yisi day an edict put yuyue Xiuge in charge of Yuancheng.
units.literal: On yisi day an edict ordered yuyue Xiuge to oversee Yuancheng.

units.zh: 壬子，韓德威表請伐党項之復叛者，詔許之；
units.en: On renzi day Han Dewei memorialized requesting a campaign against the Tangut who had rebelled again; the court approved;
units.literal: On renzi day Han Dewei memorialized requesting a campaign against the Tangut who had rebelled again; an edict approved it;

units.zh: 仍發別部兵數千以助之。
units.en: several thousand troops from a separate division were also dispatched to assist.
units.literal: several thousand troops of a separate division were also dispatched to assist.

units.zh: 九月癸丑朔，以東京、平州旱、蝗，詔振之。
units.en: On the guichou new moon of the ninth month, because the Eastern Capital and Pingzhou suffered drought and locusts, an edict ordered relief.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on the guichou new moon, because the Eastern Capital and Pingzhou suffered drought and locusts, an edict ordered relief.

units.zh: 乙卯，謁永興、長寧、敦睦三宮。
units.en: On yimao day the court visited the Yongxing, Changning, and Dunmu palaces in homage.
units.literal: On yimao day the court paid respects at the Yongxing, Changning, and Dunmu palaces.

units.zh: 丙辰，南京留守奏，秋霖害稼，請權停關征，以通山西糴易，從之。
units.en: On bingchen day the Nanjing regent reported that autumn rains had ruined the harvest and asked that frontier tolls be suspended temporarily to allow grain trade with Shanxi; the request was granted.
units.literal: On bingchen day the Nanjing regent reported that autumn rains had damaged the crops and requested a temporary suspension of frontier tolls to allow grain trade with Shanxi; this was approved.

units.zh: 庚申，謁宣簡皇帝廟。
units.en: On gengshen day the court visited the temple of Emperor Xuanjian in homage.
units.literal: On gengshen day the court paid respects at the temple of Emperor Xuanjian.

units.zh: 辛酉，幸祖州，謁祖陵。
units.en: On xinyou day the court went to Zuzhou and paid homage at the ancestral mausoleum.
units.literal: On xinyou day the court visited Zuzhou and paid respects at the ancestral mausoleum.

units.zh: 壬戌，還上京。
units.en: On renxu day the Emperor returned to the Supreme Capital.
units.literal: On renxu day, he returned to the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 辛未，有司請以帝生日為千齡節，從之。
units.en: On xinwei day the authorities petitioned to designate the Emperor's birthday as the Thousand-Age Festival, and the request was granted.
units.literal: On xinwei day, the officials requested making the Emperor's birthday the Thousand-Age Festival; it was approved.

units.zh: 皇太后言故於越屋只有傅導功，宜錄其子孫；
units.en: The Empress Dowager said that the late yuyue Wuzhi had earned merit chiefly as tutor and guide and that his descendants deserved recognition;
units.literal: The Empress Dowager said that the late yuyue Wuzhi had only the merit of instructing and guiding and that his descendants ought to be recorded;

units.zh: 遂命其子泮泱為林牙。
units.en: His son Panyang was accordingly appointed linyal.
units.literal: His son Panyang was then appointed linyal.

units.zh: 丙子，如老翁川。
units.en: On bingzi day the Emperor went to Old Man River.
units.literal: On bingzi day, he went to Old Man River.

units.zh: 冬十月癸未朔，司天奏老人星見。
units.en: On the guiwei new moon of the tenth winter month the Directorate of Astronomy reported the appearance of the Old Man star.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on guiwei day the new moon, the Directorate of Astronomy reported that the Old Man star appeared.

units.zh: 戊子，以公主淑哥下嫁國舅詳穩照姑。
units.en: On wuzi day Princess Shuge was married to the Empress's brother, xiangwen Zhaogu.
units.literal: On wuzi day, Princess Shuge was given in marriage below to the Empress's brother xiangwen Zhaogu.

units.zh: 癸巳，速撒奏敵烈部及叛蕃來降，悉復故地。
units.en: On guisi day Susa reported that the Dilie division and rebellious tribes had submitted and that all lost territory had been recovered.
units.literal: On guisi day, Susa memorialized that the Dilie division and rebel tribes had surrendered and all former territory was recovered.

units.zh: 乙未，以燕京留守於越休哥言，每歲諸節度使貢獻，如契丹官例，止進鞍馬，從之。
units.en: On yiwei day, acting on memorial from yuyue Xiuge, regent of Yanjing, that circuit commissioners should follow Khitan precedent and present only saddles and horses as annual tribute, the court agreed.
units.literal: On yiwei day, on the word of yuyue Xiuge, Yanjing regent, that each year the military commissioners' tribute, following Khitan official precedent, should only present saddles and horses; it was approved.

units.zh: 丁酉，以吳王稍為上京留守，行臨潢尹事。
units.en: On dingyou day Prince of Wu Shao was appointed regent of the Supreme Capital and acted concurrently as intendant of Linhuang.
units.literal: On dingyou day, Prince of Wu Shao was made Supreme Capital regent and acted as Linhuang intendant.

units.zh: 上將征高麗，親閱東京留守耶律末只所總兵馬。
units.en: Preparing to campaign against Goryeo, the Emperor personally inspected the forces under Eastern Capital regent Yelü Mojie.
units.literal: The Emperor was about to campaign against Goryeo and personally reviewed the troops under Eastern Capital regent Yelü Mojie.

units.zh: 丙午，命宣徽使兼侍中蒲領、林牙肯德等將兵東討，賜旗鼓及銀符。
units.en: On bingwu day Pulie, commissioner of the Palace Attendants and concurrent Palace Attendant, Kend the linyal, and others were ordered east with an expeditionary force and were granted campaign drums, banners, and silver tally-seals.
units.literal: On bingwu day, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants and concurrent Palace Attendant Pulie, linyal Kend, and others were ordered to lead troops east in punitive campaign; drums, banners, and silver tally-seals were granted.

units.zh: 十一月壬子朔，觀漁撻馬濼。
units.en: On the renzi new moon of the eleventh month the court watched the fishing at Tama Marsh.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on renzi day the new moon, fishing was observed at Tama Marsh.

units.zh: 癸丑，應州奏，獲宋諜者，言宋除道五臺山，將入靈丘界。
units.en: On guichou day Yingzhou reported the capture of a Song spy who said Song was opening a route at Mount Wutai and would enter the Lingqiu frontier.
units.literal: On guichou day, Yingzhou memorialized that a Song spy had been captured who said Song was clearing a road at Mount Wutai and would enter Lingqiu territory.

units.zh: 詔諜者及居停人並磔於市。
units.en: An edict ordered the spy and those who had sheltered him torn apart by carts in the marketplace.
units.literal: An edict ordered the spy and those who harbored him all dismembered at the market.

units.zh: 庚辰，上與皇太后祭乾陵，下詔諭三京左右相、左右平章事、副留守判官、諸道節度使判官、諸軍事判官、錄事參軍等，當執公方，毋得阿順。
units.en: On gengchen day the Emperor and Empress Dowager sacrificed at Qian Mausoleum and issued an edict to the chancellors, vice-regents, circuit and army staff, and recording secretaries of the three capitals, directing them to govern with impartial integrity and not to flatter and yield.
units.literal: On gengchen day, the Emperor and Empress Dowager sacrificed at Qian Mausoleum and issued an edict instructing the left and right chancellors of the three capitals, left and right co-chancellors, deputy regents and administrative assistants, military commissioners' assistants of all circuits, military affairs assistants, recording secretaries, and others that they should uphold public rectitude and not cringe and comply.

units.zh: 諸縣令佐如遇州官及朝使非理征求，毋或畏徇。
units.en: County magistrates and assistants who encounter unlawful exactions from prefectural officials or imperial envoys must not give way out of fear.
units.literal: When county magistrates and assistants meet unreasonable demands from prefectural officials or court envoys, they must not fear and comply.

units.zh: 恒加采聽，以為殿最。
units.en: They were to keep constant watch and use what they learned to rank officials for promotion and demotion.
units.literal: They shall constantly gather intelligence, using it to grade performance.

units.zh: 民間有父母在，別籍異居者，聽鄰裏覺察，坐之。
units.en: Commoners who kept separate households while their parents still lived were to be reported by neighbors and punished.
units.literal: Among the people, those who have living parents yet separate registers and live apart, let neighbors report them and they shall be punished.

units.zh: 有孝於父母，三世同居者，旌其門閭。
units.en: Families noted for filial piety and three generations living together were to have their gates and lanes publicly honored.
units.literal: Those filial toward parents and living together for three generations, their gates and lanes shall be honored.

units.zh: 十二月壬午朔，謁凝神殿，遣使分祭諸陵，賜守殿官屬酒。
units.en: On the renwu new moon of the twelfth month the Emperor visited Ningshen Hall, sent envoys to offer sacrifice at the various mausoleums, and granted wine to the officials who guarded the halls.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on renwu day the new moon, he visited Ningshen Hall, dispatched envoys to sacrifice separately at the various mausoleums, and granted wine to the officials guarding the halls.

units.zh: 是日，幸顯州。
units.en: That day the Emperor visited Xian Prefecture.
units.literal: That day, he visited Xian Prefecture.

units.zh: 丁亥，以顯州歲貢綾錦分賜左右。
units.en: On dinghai day the annual tribute of silk brocade from Xian Prefecture was divided and distributed to the left and right offices.
units.literal: On dinghai day, the annual tribute of silk brocade from Xian Prefecture was divided and granted to the left and right.

units.zh: 甲午，東幸。
units.en: On jiawu day the Emperor traveled east.
units.literal: On jiawu day, he traveled east.

units.zh: 乙亥，皇太后觀漁於玉盆灣。
units.en: On yihai day the Empress Dowager watched the fishing at Jade Basin Bay.
units.literal: On yihai day, the Empress Dowager watched fishing at Jade Basin Bay.

units.zh: 辛丑，觀漁於浚淵。
units.en: On xinchou day the court watched the fishing at Junyuan.
units.literal: On xinchou day, fishing was observed at Junyuan.

units.zh: 甲辰，敕諸刑辟已結正決遣而有冤者，聽詣臺訴。
units.en: On jiachen day an edict allowed those who believed themselves wrongfully convicted in cases already decided and sentenced to appeal to the censorate.
units.literal: On jiachen day, an edict ordered that in criminal cases already concluded and sentenced, if there is injustice, one may appeal to the censorate.

units.zh: 是夕，然萬魚燈於雙溪。
units.en: That evening ten thousand fish lanterns were lit at Twin Streams.
units.literal: That evening, ten thousand fish lanterns were lit at Twin Streams.

units.zh: 戊申，千齡節，祭日月，禮畢，百僚稱賀。
units.en: On wushen day, the Thousand-Age Festival, the court sacrificed to the sun and moon, and when the rites were finished the hundred officials offered congratulations.
units.literal: On wushen day, the Thousand-Age Festival; the sun and moon were sacrificed to; when the rites were complete, the hundred officials offered congratulations.

units.zh: 二年春正月甲子，如長濼。
units.en: In the second year, on jiazi day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Chang Marsh.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on jiazi day, he went to Chang Marsh.

units.zh: 二月癸巳，國舅帳彰德軍節度使蕭闥覽來朝。
units.en: On guisi day in the second month Zhangde Army Military Commissioner Xiao Talan of the Empress's brother's branch came to court.
units.literal: In the second month, on guisi day, Empress's brother's branch Zhangde Army Military Commissioner Xiao Talan came to court.

units.zh: 甲午，賜將軍耶律敵不春衣、束帶。
units.en: On jiawu day General Yelü Dibu was granted spring garments and a girdle.
units.literal: On jiawu day, General Yelü Dibu was granted spring garments and a girdle.

units.zh: 丙申，東路行軍、宣徽使耶律蒲寧奏討女直捷，遣使執手獎諭。
units.en: On bingshen day Eastern Route field commander and commissioner of the Palace Attendants Yelü Puning reported victory over the Jurchen, and envoys were sent to clasp his hands in praise.
units.literal: On bingshen day, Eastern Route field commander and Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Yelü Puning memorialized victory over the Jurchen; envoys were dispatched to clasp hands and commend him.

units.zh: 庚子，朝皇太后，太后因從觀獵於饒樂川。
units.en: On gengzi day the Emperor attended upon the Empress Dowager, who then accompanied him to watch the hunt at Raole River.
units.literal: On gengzi day, he attended upon the Empress Dowager; the Empress Dowager then followed to watch the hunt at Raole River.

units.zh: 乙巳，五國烏隈於厥節度使耶律隗窪以所轄諸部難治，乞賜詔給劍，便宜行事，從之。
units.en: On yisi day Five States Wuyu Wujue Military Commissioner Yelü Kuiwa, finding the tribes under his command difficult to govern, petitioned for an edict and sword granting discretionary authority, and the request was granted.
units.literal: On yisi day, Five States Wuyu Wujue Military Commissioner Yelü Kuiwa, because the tribes under his jurisdiction were hard to govern, requested an edict granting a sword to act at discretion; it was approved.

units.zh: 丙午，上與諸王大臣較射。
units.en: On bingwu day the Emperor and the princes and great ministers held an archery contest.
units.literal: On bingwu day, the Emperor and the princes and great ministers competed in archery.

units.zh: 丁未，韓德威以征党項回，遂襲河東，獻所俘，賜詔褒美。
units.en: On dingwei day Han Dewei, returning from the Tangut campaign, raided Hedong and presented prisoners; an edict commending him was issued.
units.literal: On dingwei day, Han Dewei, returning from campaigning against the Tangut, then raided Hedong and presented captives; an edict of praise was granted.

units.zh: 三月乙卯，劃離部請今後詳穩止從本部選授為宜，上曰：「諸部官惟在得人，豈得定以所部為限。」
units.en: On yimao day in the third month the Huali division petitioned that xiangwen posts should henceforth be filled only from within their own division; the Emperor said, "Officials among the tribes must be chosen for ability — how can appointments be fixed by tribal limits alone."
units.literal: In the third month, on yimao day, the Huali division requested that henceforth xiangwen posts be appointed only from within their own division; the Emperor said, "For officials among the divisions, what matters is getting the right men — how can appointment be fixed by division alone."

units.zh: 不允。
units.en: The petition was denied.
units.literal: The request was denied.

units.zh: 贈故同平章事趙延煦兼侍中。
units.en: The late co-chancellor Zhao Yanxu was posthumously granted the additional rank of Palace Attendant.
units.literal: The late co-chancellor Zhao Yanxu was posthumously granted the additional title of Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 夏四月丁亥，宣徽使、同平章事耶律普寧、都監蕭勤德獻征女直捷，授普寧兼政事令，勤德神武衛大將軍，各賜金器諸物。
units.en: On dinghai day in the fourth summer month commissioner of the Palace Attendants and co-chancellor Yelü Puning and overseer Xiao Qinde reported victory over the Jurchen; Puning was made concurrent chief councillor, Qinde grand general of the Divine Martial Guard, and each received gold vessels and other gifts.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on dinghai day, Commissioner of the Palace Attendants and co-chancellor Yelü Puning and overseer Xiao Qinde presented victory over the Jurchen; Puning was made concurrent Chief Councillor, Qinde Grand General of the Divine Martial Guard, and each was granted gold vessels and other goods.

units.zh: 庚寅，皇太后臨決滯獄。
units.en: On gengyin day the Empress Dowager personally adjudicated delayed cases.
units.literal: On gengyin day, the Empress Dowager personally decided delayed cases.

units.zh: 辛卯，祭風伯。
units.en: On xinmao day the court sacrificed to the Wind Lord.
units.literal: On xinmao day, the Wind Lord was sacrificed to.

units.zh: 壬辰，以宣徽南院使劉承規為承德軍節度使，崇德宮都部署、保義軍節度使張德筠為宣徽北院使。
units.en: On renchen day Southern Palace Attendants Commissioner Liu Chenggui was appointed Chengde Army military commissioner, and Chongde Palace chief deployer and Baoyi Army Military Commissioner Zhang Deyun was appointed Northern Palace Attendants Commissioner.
units.literal: On renchen day, Southern Palace Attendants Commissioner Liu Chenggui was made Chengde Army Military Commissioner, and Chongde Palace Chief Deployer and Baoyi Army Military Commissioner Zhang Deyun was made Northern Palace Attendants Commissioner.

units.zh: 五月乙卯，祠木葉山。
units.en: On yimao day in the fifth month the court offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on yimao day, sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.

units.zh: 丁丑，駐蹕沿柳湖。
units.en: On dingchou day the court encamped at Willow Lake along the route.
units.literal: On dingchou day, the court halted at Willow Lake along the route.

units.zh: 六月己卯朔，皇太后決獄，至月終。
units.en: On the jimao new moon of the sixth month the Empress Dowager held court to decide cases and continued through the end of the month.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on jimao day the new moon, the Empress Dowager decided cases, continuing until the month's end.

units.zh: 秋七月癸丑，皇太后行再生禮。
units.en: On guichou day in the seventh autumn month the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth rite.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on guichou day, the Empress Dowager performed the rebirth rite.

units.zh: 八月辛卯，東京留守兼侍中耶律末只奏，女直朮不直、賽裏等八族乞舉眾內附，詔納之。
units.en: On xinmao day in the eighth month Eastern Capital regent and concurrent Palace Attendant Yelü Mojie reported that the Jurchen chiefs Jubuzhi, Saili, and seven other clans wished to bring their people in submission, and an edict ordered them received.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on xinmao day, Eastern Capital regent and concurrent Palace Attendant Yelü Mojie memorialized that Jurchen chiefs Jubuzhi, Saili, and seven other clans requested to bring their people in submission; an edict ordered them received.

units.zh: 九月戊申朔，駐蹕土河。
units.en: On the wushen new moon of the ninth month the court encamped at Tu River.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on wushen day the new moon, the court halted at Tu River.

units.zh: 辛未，以景宗忌日，詔諸道京鎮遣官行香飯僧。
units.en: On xinwei day, Jingzong's death anniversary, an edict ordered every circuit and capital garrison to send officials to burn incense and feed the monks.
units.literal: On xinwei day, because it was Jingzong's death anniversary, an edict ordered all circuits and capital garrisons to dispatch officials to burn incense and feed monks.

units.zh: 冬十月丁丑朔，以歸化州刺史耶律普寧為彰德軍節度使，右武衛大將軍韓倬為彰國軍節度使兼侍衛親軍兵馬都指揮使。
units.en: On the dingchou new moon of the tenth winter month Guihua Prefecture Military Commissioner Yelü Puning was appointed Zhangde Army military commissioner, and Right Martial Guard Grand General Han Zhuo was appointed Zhangguo Army military commissioner and concurrent commander of the Palace Guard cavalry and infantry.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on dingchou day the new moon, Guihua Prefecture Military Commissioner Yelü Puning was made Zhangde Army Military Commissioner, and Right Martial Guard Grand General Han Zhuo was made Zhangguo Army Military Commissioner and concurrent commander of the Palace Guard cavalry and infantry.

units.zh: 十一月壬子，以樞密直學士、給事中鄭嘏為儒州刺史。
units.en: On renzi day in the eleventh month Secretariat direct academician and supervising secretary Zheng Gu was appointed prefect of Ruzhou.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on renzi day, Secretariat Direct Academician and Supervising Secretary Zheng Gu was made Ruzhou prefect.

units.zh: 是月，速撒等討阻卜，殺其酋長撻剌幹。
units.en: That month Susa and others campaigned against the Zubu and killed their chieftain Talagan.
units.literal: That month, Susa and others campaigned against the Zubu and killed their chieftain Talagan.

units.zh: 十二月辛丑，以翰林學士承旨馬得臣為宣政殿學士，耶律頗德南京統軍使，耶律瑤升大內惕隱，大仁靖東京中臺省右平章事。
units.en: On xinchou day in the twelfth month Hanlin academician director Ma Dechen was appointed Xuanzheng Hall academician, Yelü Pode Nanjing army commander, Yelü Yaosheng Great Inner tihu, and Darenjing Eastern Capital Central Secretariat right co-chancellor.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinchou day, Hanlin Academician Director Ma Dechen was made Xuanzheng Hall academician, Yelü Pode was made Nanjing army commander, Yelü Yaosheng was made Great Inner tihu, and Darenjing was made Eastern Capital Central Secretariat right co-chancellor.

units.zh: 三年春正月丙午朔，如長濼。
units.en: In the third year, on the bingwu new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Chang Marsh.
units.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on bingwu day the new moon, he went to Chang Marsh.

units.zh: 丁巳，以翰林學士邢抱樸為尚書、禮部侍郎、知制誥，左拾遺知制誥劉景、吏部郎中知制誥牛藏用並政事舍人。
units.en: On dingsi day Hanlin academician Xing Baopu was appointed Minister of Rites, vice minister, and drafter of edicts; left reminder and drafter of edicts Liu Jing and Ministry of Personnel bureau director and drafter of edicts Niu Cangyong were both made administrative secretaries.
units.literal: On dingsi day, Hanlin Academician Xing Baopu was made Minister of Rites, Vice Minister, and drafter of edicts; Left Reminder and drafter of edicts Liu Jing and Ministry of Personnel Bureau Director and drafter of edicts Niu Cangyong were both made Administrative Secretaries.

units.zh: 二月丙子朔，以牛藏用知樞密直學士。
units.en: On the bingzi new moon of the second month Niu Cangyong was appointed acting Secretariat direct academician.
units.literal: In the second month, on bingzi day the new moon, Niu Cangyong was made acting Secretariat Direct Academician.

units.zh: 三月乙巳朔，樞密奏契丹諸役戶多困乏，請以富戶代之。
units.en: On the yisi new moon of the third month the Secretariat reported that many Khitan corvée households were destitute and petitioned that wealthy households be substituted in their place.
units.literal: In the third month, on yisi day the new moon, the Secretariat memorialized that many Khitan corvée households were impoverished and requested that wealthy households replace them.

units.zh: 上因閱諸部籍，涅剌、烏隈二部戶少而役重，並量免之。
units.en: The Emperor then reviewed the registers of the various divisions, found that the Niela and Wuyu divisions had few households but heavy corvée burdens, and partially exempted both.
units.literal: The Emperor thereupon reviewed the registers of the various divisions; the Niela and Wuyu divisions had few households yet heavy corvée, and both were partially exempted.

units.zh: 夏四月乙亥朔，祠木葉山。
units.en: On the yihai new moon of the fourth summer month the court offered sacrifice at Mount Muye.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on yihai day the new moon, sacrifice was performed at Mount Muye.

units.zh: 壬午，以鳳州刺史趙匡符為保靜軍節度使。
units.en: On renwu day Fengzhou Prefect Zhao Kuangfu was appointed Baojing Army military commissioner.
units.literal: On renwu day, Fengzhou Prefect Zhao Kuangfu was made Baojing Army Military Commissioner.

units.zh: 癸未，以左監門衛大將軍王庭勖為奉先軍節度使，彰武軍節度使韓德凝為崇義軍節度使。
units.en: On guiwei day Left Gate Guard Grand General Wang Tingxu was appointed Fengxian Army military commissioner, and Zhangwu Army Military Commissioner Han Dening was appointed Chongyi Army military commissioner.
units.literal: On guiwei day, Left Gate Guard Grand General Wang Tingxu was made Fengxian Army Military Commissioner, and Zhangwu Army Military Commissioner Han Dening was made Chongyi Army Military Commissioner.

units.zh: 五月壬子，還上京。
units.en: On renzi day in the fifth month the Emperor returned to the Supreme Capital.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on renzi day, he returned to the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 癸酉，以國舅蕭道寧同平章事、知沈州軍州事。
units.en: On guiyou day the Empress's brother Xiao Daoning was appointed co-chancellor and put in charge of Shenzhou military and civil affairs.
units.literal: On guiyou day, the Empress's brother Xiao Daoning was made co-chancellor and given charge of Shenzhou military and civil affairs.

units.zh: 六月甲戌朔，如柏坡。
units.en: On the jiaxu new moon of the sixth month the Emperor went to Baipo.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on jiaxu day the new moon, he went to Baipo.

units.zh: 皇太后親決滯獄。
units.en: The Empress Dowager personally adjudicated delayed cases.
units.literal: The Empress Dowager personally decided delayed cases.

units.zh: 乙亥，以歸義軍節度使王希嚴為興國軍節度使。
units.en: On yihai day Guiyi Army Military Commissioner Wang Xiyan was appointed Xingguo Army military commissioner.
units.literal: On yihai day, Guiyi Army Military Commissioner Wang Xiyan was made Xingguo Army Military Commissioner.

units.zh: 秋七月甲辰朔，詔諸道繕甲兵，以備東征高麗。
units.en: On the jiachen new moon of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered every circuit to repair armor and weapons in preparation for the eastern campaign against Goryeo.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on jiachen day the new moon, an edict ordered all circuits to repair armor and weapons in preparation for the eastern campaign against Goryeo.

units.zh: 甲寅，東幸。
units.en: On jiayin day the Emperor traveled east.
units.literal: On jiayin day, he traveled east.

units.zh: 甲子，遣郎君班賜秦王韓匡嗣葬物。
units.en: On jiazi day the langjun corps was dispatched to grant burial goods to Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi.
units.literal: On jiazi day, the langjun corps was dispatched to grant burial goods to Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi.

units.zh: 丙寅，駐蹕土河。
units.en: On bingyin day the court encamped at Tu River.
units.literal: On bingyin day, the court halted at Tu River.

units.zh: 以暴漲，命造船橋，明日乘步輦出聽政。
units.en: Because of sudden flooding he ordered a boat-bridge built, and the next day went out in a palanquin to hold court.
units.literal: Because of sudden flooding, he ordered a boat-bridge built; the next day he went out in a palanquin to hear government.

units.zh: 老人星見。
units.en: The Old Man star appeared.
units.literal: The Old Man star appeared.

units.zh: 丁卯，遣使閱東京諸軍兵器及東征道路。
units.en: On dingmao day envoys were sent to inspect the weapons of the Eastern Capital armies and the routes for the eastern campaign.
units.literal: On dingmao day, envoys were dispatched to inspect the weapons of the Eastern Capital armies and the roads for the eastern campaign.

units.zh: 以平章事蕭道寧為昭德軍節度使，武定軍節度使、守司空兼政事令郭襲為天平軍節度使，大同軍節度使、守太子太師兼政事令劉延構為義成軍節度使，贈尚父秦王韓匡嗣尚書令。
units.en: Co-chancellor Xiao Daoning was appointed Zhaode Army military commissioner; Wuding Army Military Commissioner, acting Minister of Works and concurrent chief councillor Guo Xi was appointed Tianping Army military commissioner; Datong Army Military Commissioner, acting grand preceptor of the heir apparent and concurrent chief councillor Liu Yangou was appointed Yicheng Army military commissioner; and the late honored father Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi was posthumously granted director of the Department of State Affairs.
units.literal: Co-chancellor Xiao Daoning was made Zhaode Army Military Commissioner; Wuding Army Military Commissioner, acting Minister of Works and concurrent Chief Councillor Guo Xi was made Tianping Army Military Commissioner; Datong Army Military Commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and concurrent Chief Councillor Liu Yangou was made Yicheng Army Military Commissioner; the late honored father Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi was posthumously granted Director of the Department of State Affairs.

units.zh: 八月癸酉朔，以遼澤沮洳，罷征高麗。
units.en: On the guiyou new moon of the eighth month, because Liao's marshes were waterlogged, the campaign against Goryeo was called off.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on guiyou day the new moon, because Liao's marshes were waterlogged, the campaign against Goryeo was halted.

units.zh: 命樞密使耶律斜軫為都統，駙馬都尉蕭懇德為監軍，以兵討女直。
units.en: Secretariat Commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was named commander-in-chief and imperial son-in-law commander Xiao Kende army supervisor and ordered to lead troops against the Jurchen.
units.literal: Secretariat Commissioner Yelü Xiezhen was ordered as commander-in-chief and Imperial Son-in-law Commander Xiao Kende as army supervisor to lead troops against the Jurchen.

units.zh: 丁丑，次槁城。
units.en: On dingchou day the court halted at Gaocheng.
units.literal: On dingchou day, he halted at Gaocheng.

units.zh: 庚辰，至顯州，謁凝神殿。
units.en: On gengchen day the Emperor reached Xian Prefecture and visited Ningshen Hall.
units.literal: On gengchen day, he reached Xian Prefecture and visited Ningshen Hall.

units.zh: 辛巳，幸乾州，觀新宮。
units.en: On xinsi day he visited Qian Prefecture and viewed the new palace.
units.literal: On xinsi day, he visited Qian Prefecture and viewed the new palace.

units.zh: 癸未，謁乾陵。
units.en: On guiwei day the Emperor visited Qian Mausoleum.
units.literal: On guiwei day, he visited Qian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 甲申，命南、北面臣僚分巡山陵林木，及令乾、顯二州上所部里社之數。
units.en: On jiashen day he ordered southern and northern court officials to inspect the mountain-mausoleum forests separately and directed Qian and Xian prefectures to submit counts of their subordinate villages and communities.
units.literal: On jiashen day, he ordered southern and northern court officials to inspect separately the mountain-mausoleum forests, and ordered Qian and Xian prefectures to submit the numbers of their subordinate villages and communities.

units.zh: 丙戌，北皮室詳穩進勇敢士七人。
units.en: On bingxu day Northern Pishi xiangwen presented seven brave warriors.
units.literal: On bingxu day, Northern Pishi xiangwen presented seven brave warriors.

units.zh: 戊子，故南院大王諧領已裏婉妻蕭氏奏夫死不能葬，詔有司助之。
units.en: On wuzi day the widow of the late Southern Court Great King Xieling Yiliwan, Lady Xiao, memorialized that her husband had died and could not be buried, and an edict ordered the authorities to assist.
units.literal: On wuzi day, the widow of the late Southern Court Great King Xieling Yiliwan, Lady Xiao, memorialized that her husband had died and could not be buried; an edict ordered the authorities to assist.

units.zh: 庚辰，東征都統所奏路尚陷濘，未可進討，詔俟澤涸深入。
units.en: On gengchen day the eastern campaign commander-in-chief reported that the roads were still boggy and advance was not yet possible; an edict ordered the army to wait until the marshes dried before pushing deep inland.
units.literal: On gengchen day, the eastern campaign commander-in-chief memorialized that the roads were still mired and advance was not yet possible; an edict ordered waiting until the marshes dried to push deep inward.

units.zh: 癸巳，皇太后謁顯陵。
units.en: On guisi day the Empress Dowager visited Xian Mausoleum.
units.literal: On guisi day, the Empress Dowager visited Xian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 庚子，謁乾陵。
units.en: On gengzi day the Emperor visited Qian Mausoleum.
units.literal: On gengzi day, he visited Qian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 辛丑，西幸。
units.en: On xinchou day the Emperor traveled west.
units.literal: On xinchou day, he traveled west.

units.zh: 閏九月癸酉，命邢抱樸勾檢顯陵。
units.en: On guiyou day in the intercalary ninth month Xing Baopu was ordered to audit Xian Mausoleum.
units.literal: In the intercalary ninth month, on guiyou day, Xing Baopu was ordered to audit Xian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 丙子，行次海上。
units.en: On bingzi day the march halted at the seashore.
units.literal: On bingzi day, the march halted at the seashore.

units.zh: 庚辰，重九，駱駝山登高，賜群臣菊花酒。
units.en: On gengchen day, the Double Ninth Festival, the Emperor climbed Camel Mountain and granted chrysanthemum wine to the ministers.
units.literal: On gengchen day, the Double Ninth, he climbed high at Camel Mountain and granted chrysanthemum wine to the ministers.

units.zh: 辛巳，詔諭東征將帥，乘水涸進討。
units.en: On xinsi day an edict instructed the eastern campaign generals to advance when the waters had receded.
units.literal: On xinsi day, an edict instructed the eastern campaign generals to advance when the waters receded.

units.zh: 丙申，女直宰相朮不裏來貢。
units.en: On bingshen day Jurchen chancellor Jubuli came with tribute.
units.literal: On bingshen day, Jurchen chancellor Jubuli came with tribute.

units.zh: 戊戌，駐蹕東古山。
units.en: On wuxu day the court encamped at Donggu Mountain.
units.literal: On wuxu day, the court halted at Donggu Mountain.

units.zh: 己亥，速撒奏朮不姑諸部至近澱，夷離堇易魯姑請行俘掠，上曰：「諸部於國無惡，何故俘掠，徒生事耳。」
units.en: On jihai day Susa reported that the Jubugu tribes had reached the near marshlands and yilijin Yilugu asked permission to raid for captives; the Emperor said, "These tribes have done the state no harm — why raid for captives and needlessly stir up trouble."
units.literal: On jihai day, Susa memorialized that the Jubugu tribes had reached the near marshlands; yilijin Yilugu requested to carry out captive raids; the Emperor said, "These divisions have done no harm to the state — why carry out captive raids and needlessly stir up trouble."

units.zh: 不允。
units.en: The request was denied.
units.literal: The request was denied.

units.zh: 冬十一月甲戌，詔吳王稍領秦王韓匡嗣葬祭事。
units.en: On jiaxu day in the eleventh winter month an edict put Prince of Wu Shao in charge of the burial rites for Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi.
units.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on jiaxu day, an edict ordered Prince of Wu Shao to oversee the burial rites of Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi.

units.zh: 丁丑，詔以東北路兵馬監軍妻婆底裏存撫邊民。
units.en: On dingchou day an edict ordered Podili, wife of the Northeast Route army-and-horse supervisor, to reassure the border population.
units.literal: On dingchou day, an edict ordered Podili, wife of the Northeast Route army-and-horse supervisor, to comfort the border people.

units.zh: 戊寅，賜公主胡骨典葬夫金帛、工匠。
units.en: On wuyin day Princess Hugudian was granted gold, silk, and artisans for her husband's burial.
units.literal: On wuyin day, Princess Hugudian was granted gold and silk and artisans for her husband's burial.

units.zh: 辛卯，以韓德讓兼政事令。
units.en: On xinmao day Han Derang was also appointed Chief Councillor.
units.literal: On xinmao day Han Derang was concurrently made Chief Councillor.

units.zh: 癸巳，禁行在市易布帛不中尺度者。
units.en: On guisi day the court forbade the sale in markets of cloth and silk that did not meet standard dimensions.
units.literal: On guisi day the sale in markets of cloth and silk that failed to meet standard measures was forbidden.

units.zh: 丙申，東征女直，都統蕭闥覽、菩薩奴以行軍所經地裏、物產來上。
units.en: On bingshen day, during the eastern campaign against the Jurchen, supreme commanders Xiao Talan and Pusa Nu submitted reports on distances along the march route and on local products.
units.literal: On bingshen day, on the eastern expedition against the Jurchen, supreme commanders Xiao Talan and Pusa Nu presented the distances and local products along the army's route.
